cohort: 595 women who underwent operative vaginal delivery (OVD), of which 28 were unsuccessful
finding: Risk factors for unsuccessful OVD included higher birth weight and induction of labor, and unsuccessful OVD was associated with a higher incidence of postpartum hemorrhage and NICU admission compared to successful OVD.
mod_finding: The abstract focuses on comparing successful and unsuccessful operative vaginal deliveries, not specific modes of delivery like cesarean section.
birth_weight: Mean birthweight was significantly higher in the unsuccessful OVD group compared to the successful OVD group (3.695 kg vs. 3.483 kg).
